basis: Hershey’s May 1 actuals establish that Q1 2025 consolidated reported net sales were $2,805,419,000, below the $3,090,111,550 cutoff. On February 6, the CFO had forecast a mid-teens decline in Q1 total-company net sales without specifying a numeric endpoint. The February 18 CAGNY slide deck was recovered, but the accessible transcript ends before the CFO’s financial discussion. That gap prevents verification that May 1 was the earliest qualifying disclosure.

coverage.detail: The November 7, 2024 Q3 release revised the full-year 2024 sales outlook. It supplied no Q1 2025 sales bound.
The Q3 prepared remarks discussed 2025 sales growth relative to Hershey’s long-term target. That expectation covered the year.
Hershey’s November 7 Q&A transcript contains no explicit numeric upper bound for Q1 2025 consolidated sales.
The January 10 succession announcement reaffirmed the 2024 full-year outlook and deferred the 2025 outlook to February earnings.
The February 6 Q4 release guided to at least 2% net sales growth for full-year 2025. It also identified the separately posted management discussion.

The CFO said, “First quarter total company net sales are expected to decline mid-teens.” This is the correct quarter and reported-sales measure, but it gives no numeric endpoint. An earlier passage discusses organic, constant-currency sales for two segments.
At the February 6 live Q&A, IR confirmed publication of the recording and transcript. Management discussed two fewer Q1 shipping days without giving a numeric Q1 consolidated sales bound.
Hershey’s 9:12 a.m. CAGNY announcement reaffirmed the full-year outlook ahead of the presentation and directed readers to its event calendar.
The conference host confirms Hershey’s February 18 session from 1:00 to 1:50 p.m. Its Hershey agenda entry supplies no replay or transcript link.

The calendar linked by Hershey redirects to its current IR site. Following its investor-events link did not recover the 2025 CAGNY recording. The paginated archive attempt at https://hershey.gcs-web.com/events/?page=0%2C1 was inaccessible.

Recovered Hershey’s February 18 deck from its presentation design partner. Slide 36, in CFO Steve Voskuil’s section, reaffirms at least 2% reported and organic net sales growth for 2025. The searchable deck yielded no Q1 consolidated sales bound.

This copy credits Hershey with publishing the transcript on February 25. The accessible text cuts off mid-sentence at page 10 during the CEO’s international discussion. The original-document label exposed no retrievable link.
The second transcript copy ends at the same page 10 cutoff. Neither copy verifies what the CFO said.
This separate transcript listing identifies the session and speakers. Its publicly readable excerpt did not reach the CFO’s remarks.

The February 20 exhibit announces a notes offering. Its companion pricing exhibit, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/47111/000162828025006795/exhibit992-pricingpressrel.htm, concerns the same financing. Neither supplies a Q1 sales bound.
The April 3 notice scheduled the Q1 results for May 1 and supplied no preliminary sales figure.

The consolidated income statement reports net sales in thousands of 2,805,419 for the quarter ended March 30, 2025 and 3,252,749 for the quarter ended March 31, 2024. Hershey reports a 13.8% decline on that basis. Its separate 13.2% organic, constant-currency decline excludes acquisition and currency effects.

publication_date_evidence: The Q4 prepared transcript bears February 5, but Hershey scheduled public posting for approximately 7:00 a.m. Eastern on February 6 and confirmed posting during the 8:30 a.m. Q&A. CAGNY’s agenda establishes February 18 as the live session date. The actual-results release is dated May 1, 2025, and EDGAR records acceptance of the release-bearing 8-K at 06:47:38 that day: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/47111/000004711125000040/0000047111-25-000040-index.htm.
